name: Tome of the Cabal (quest item)
summary: Warlocks in Ratchet receive the Tome of the Cabal from Strahad Farsan after gathering dangerous components. Its pages hold the incantations for drawing a felhunter across the Twisting Nether and binding it.

sections.title: A Gateway to the Nether
sections.body: A felhunter is a vicious beast from the chaotic Twisting Nether, feared for devouring mana. Subduing one marks a passage for seasoned warlocks. The Tome of the Cabal holds the rites for opening a path to such a demon. Strahad Farsan, an experienced conjurer in Ratchet, gives the tome to an aspirant only after they gather the rare and dangerous components its magic requires.

sections.title: The Summoning Ritual
sections.body: Strahad Farsan establishes the primary summoning circle in his sanctum, while his acolytes use rods of channeling to form a greater protective boundary. The warlock recites the tome's exact incantations and drags the felhunter into our world. The demon must be battled at once and subdued, binding it to the warlock's will.

faq.q: What is the Tome of the Cabal used for?
aliases: what does tome of the cabal do
faq.answer: The Tome of the Cabal holds the incantations for summoning a felhunter from the Twisting Nether into a prepared circle in Ratchet, where a warlock can face and bind the demon.

faq.q: Who provides the Tome of the Cabal?
aliases: who gives tome of the cabal
where to get tome of the cabal
faq.answer: Strahad Farsan, a warlock mentor living in the hills above Ratchet in the Barrens, provides the tome after a practitioner completes the arduous preparations.

faq.q: Do you keep the tome after completing the ritual?
faq.answer: No. After defeating the summoned felhunter and proving your mastery, you return the Tome of the Cabal to Strahad Farsan as proof of your success.

faq.q: Can you summon the felhunter anywhere in the world?
faq.answer: No. You must read the incantations in Strahad Farsan's sanctuary above Ratchet, where he and his acolytes maintain the greater and lesser summoning circles needed to contain the arriving beast.

angles.text: As a warlock, you must master this tome to claim a felhunter companion and gain dominion over demonic magic.
